title: GB constraints — Neura Atlas snapshot
about: GB layers from the Neura Constraint Atlas: SO-flagged wind turn-down by BM unit, NESO day-ahead boundary forecasts on ETYS lines, interconnector outturn, the GB wind curtailment index, and each DNO's own curtailment or ANM measure with the DNOs' GSP service areas. Every figure names its method; every source key is open or owner-authorised for NeuraMap (owner_authorised_2026-11-26); see docs/ATLAS_BRIDGE.md.

language: Curtailment here is net SO-flagged turn-down against FPN. Boundary figures are NESO forecasts. Mappings are unverified. Elexon figures are indicative. Each DNO's figure is in that DNO's own definition and is never added to another DNO's or to transmission turn-down.

owner_authorised.scope: NeuraMap only; the Atlas's own gate is unchanged
